historical_record.description: Redevelopment Agency inspectors recorded apartments in a three-storey building, with a shed. The exterior was in poor condition and the interior fair.
Built as three flats, three storeys over a basement; converted to ten units some time before 1946.
A permit was issued to install a garage and a fireproof passageway.
A permit was issued to install fire escapes at the front and rear and to stucco the front.
A permit was issued to install asbestos siding.

In the Redevelopment Agency's 1962 acquisition appraisal for Western Addition A-2, the appraiser Maury Holmes put the market value of the property at $25,500 and rated it in fair condition. He described a three-story frame building with seven rooms on each floor, three kitchens and a shared bath per floor, and a storage basement with one garage; the appraiser could not go inside.
